{"self_assessment": "Impact: I set the direction early, starting the fish at the tail and running right to left, and I laid the top line and start domino. I can't yet confirm the outcome of the push. Before the push, the bottom edge was still being laid by Tom, and I never checked the fork or the tails myself, so I can't claim the fish was recognisable.

Execution: My top line was built cleanly and I confirmed it was connected to START. The start domino was late: I announced it several times between 7:15 and 8:30, and it was only down near the end. I should have laid it earlier, when the top line was finished. I also didn't do the final fork and tail check I had planned for after Tom's call.

Collaboration: I kept clear of Tom's bottom join as he asked, and I gave the table regular updates on what I was doing so no one doubled up. Maya and Priya knew which strokes were theirs, and the handoffs on the tail tips went smoothly.

Leadership: I took the pad and got a plan agreed within the first minute, and I checked stroke ownership at the midpoint. But I didn't hold a firm pre-push check, and I left the joint question to Tom rather than pushing for a final connectivity check before time ran out. Next time I'd set a hard checkpoint about five minutes before the end and hold everyone to it."}
